Definition: from G2596 (intensively) and G1497; utterly idolatrous:--wholly given to idolatry.
BiblicalUsage: Paul's spirit was stirred within him when he saw the city wholly given to idolatry.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe a city full of idols should stir the spirit, not dull it.
